title: Email: isolation hydraulics for Orchard Standpipe

fields.subject: Orchard Standpipe: isolation levels and wells
fields.body:
Hilltop Tank 26.5 ft — above the 15 ft needed to isolate Orchard Standpipe without dropping Zone 2 below 20 psi (ERP 8.2).

W-1 to W-3 must be stopped on RTU-06 before the standpipe is closed or they will fill it to overflow. That removes 3.6 MGD; at today’s demand Hilltop Tank will fall about 0.4 ft an hour.

Mill Road Booster Station can lift Zone 1 water into Zone 2 if Hilltop falls too far.

Streets fed directly from the standpipe are marked on the attached map of record extract.

instructorNote: The isolation is possible today; watch for the wells being stopped first and a booster trigger level.

snapshot.title: Advisory Approved — Zone 2 Precautionary Boil-Water

fields.to: Public Information Officer (PIO); Director of Water Operations (Incident Commander)
fields.subject: Advisory approved. Per Section 5.4, the precautionary boil-water advisory for Zone 2 is approved.
fields.body:
WQ,

The precautionary boil-water advisory for Zone 2 is approved per Section 5.4 of the Public Communications Plan (MDWS-PCP-2026). Field evidence (ORCH-001), lab results (LAB-002-2025), and system drift (AIT-611) confirm a potential malevolent act at the Orchard Standpipe.

Submit to MillbrookAlert, the city website (millbrook-oh.example), and social media channels immediately.

Notify Ohio EPA DDAGW via pre-scripted template (Section 12) within 30 minutes.

Initiate sampling plan under ERP-3. All critical customers to be notified by 09:00.

This is a Tier 1 situation. No further delay.

— Marcus
fields.signature:
Marcus Oyelaran, Water Quality Manager
City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer
(555) 032-6000

snapshot.instructorNote: Final advisory approval. The PIO must now trigger the full release sequence in order, using the approved templates and timing from C2 and C6.
